Pick a note. The needle shows how far you are from it, not from the nearest note.

Pick the key of your song. Green means you are in tune on a note that belongs to the key.

Each note of the scale lights up once you have held it in tune.

The video plays here and your voice is drawn on the chart underneath. Wear headphones so the mic doesn't hear the song.

A voice-only recording works best. The app maps its notes onto the chart, plays it back, and you can sing along.
